verdicts.reason: A splits the 'WEEKEND ONLY' eyebrow into the left column, away from its '20% off' headline, and shrinks the shoe into a small cutout sitting at the bottom of the circle. Its legal line is microscopic and unreadable, the left edge of the Shop Sale button has a notch artifact, and the left half is mostly dead space. B keeps the original reading order and the circle-plus-shoe motif, but the eyebrow and subhead are indented off the headline's left edge. The legal text is almost as large as the subhead and jammed against the button, and the CTA sits cramped near the bottom edge.
